Desktop OS.reason: GNU Emacs command injection via filenames allows local attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands, compromising developer workstations and automated build environments.
Desktop OS.reason_en: GNU Emacs command injection via filenames allows local attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands, compromising developer workstations and automated build environments.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: GNU Emacs 文件名命令注入漏洞允许本地攻击者执行任意操作系统命令，从而危及开发人员工作站和自动化构建环境。

Desktop OS.reason: Improper sanitization of login arguments in the TRAMP module enables local privilege escalation and remote code execution through crafted file paths.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Improper sanitization of login arguments in the TRAMP module enables local privilege escalation and remote code execution through crafted file paths.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: TRAMP 模块中登录参数清理不当，导致攻击者可通过构造的文件路径实现本地权限提升和远程代码执行。

Mobile Security.reason: Path traversal in the Android-based Lippu Docx Reader app allows remote attackers to access restricted file paths, potentially exposing sensitive device data and violating user privacy.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Path traversal in the Android-based Lippu Docx Reader app allows remote attackers to access restricted file paths, potentially exposing sensitive device data and violating user privacy.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Android 版 Lippu Docx Reader 应用存在路径遍历漏洞，允许远程攻击者访问受限文件路径，可能导致敏感设备数据泄露并侵犯用户隐私。

IoT Security.reason: Flawed entropy handling in the NXP MCUX TRNG driver compromises cryptographic randomness on i.MX RT series microcontrollers, undermining foundational device security mechanisms.
IoT Security.reason_en: Flawed entropy handling in the NXP MCUX TRNG driver compromises cryptographic randomness on i.MX RT series microcontrollers, undermining foundational device security mechanisms.
IoT Security.reason_zh: NXP MCUX TRNG 驱动程序的熵处理缺陷破坏了 i.MX RT 系列微控制器的密码学随机性，削弱了设备的基础安全机制。

Cloud Security.reason: Insufficient input validation in AWS Bedrock AgentCore allows authenticated users to bypass model invocation controls and execute unauthorized tools within cloud AI workflows.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Insufficient input validation in AWS Bedrock AgentCore allows authenticated users to bypass model invocation controls and execute unauthorized tools within cloud AI workflows.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: AWS Bedrock AgentCore 输入验证不足，允许已认证用户绕过模型调用控制，在云 AI 工作流中执行未授权工具。

Cloud Security.reason: Remote OS command injection in OpenSpug Spug's file transfer module enables complete server takeover; the publication of a working exploit significantly increases real-world exploitation risk.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Remote OS command injection in OpenSpug Spug's file transfer module enables complete server takeover; the publication of a working exploit significantly increases real-world exploitation risk.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: OpenSpug Spug 文件传输模块存在远程操作系统命令注入漏洞，可导致服务器被完全接管；有效利用工具的公开显著增加了实际利用风险。

Network Devices.reason: Critical OS command injection in the TOZED X300 IPPingDiagnostics handler permits unauthenticated remote attackers to fully compromise network-connected printing infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_en: Critical OS command injection in the TOZED X300 IPPingDiagnostics handler permits unauthenticated remote attackers to fully compromise network-connected printing infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_zh: TOZED X300 IPPingDiagnostics 处理程序存在严重操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许未认证的远程攻击者完全接管联网打印基础设施。

Industrial Control.reason: Unauthenticated deserialization of client-supplied data structures in openPDC enables remote code execution on critical power grid monitoring systems lacking Windows Authentication.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Unauthenticated deserialization of client-supplied data structures in openPDC enables remote code execution on critical power grid monitoring systems lacking Windows Authentication.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: openPDC 对客户端提供的数据结构进行未认证反序列化，可在缺乏 Windows 身份验证的关键电网监控系统上实现远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Missing authentication and nonce checks combined with unsanitized input in a WooCommerce plugin allow unauthenticated remote code execution on compromised WordPress sites.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing authentication and nonce checks combined with unsanitized input in a WooCommerce plugin allow unauthenticated remote code execution on compromised WordPress sites.
Web Security.reason_zh: WooCommerce 插件中缺失身份验证和一次性令牌（nonce）检查，结合未清理的输入，导致受入侵的 WordPress 站点可被未认证攻击者远程执行代码。

Web Security.reason: Arbitrary file upload vulnerability in a Contact Form 7 extension plugin bypasses MIME and extension validation, enabling attackers to deploy persistent web shells.
Web Security.reason_en: Arbitrary file upload vulnerability in a Contact Form 7 extension plugin bypasses MIME and extension validation, enabling attackers to deploy persistent web shells.
Web Security.reason_zh: Contact Form 7 扩展插件存在任意文件上传漏洞，绕过了 MIME 类型和扩展名验证，使攻击者能够部署持久化 Web Shell。

Web Security.reason: Authentication bypass in the Advanced IP Blocker plugin occurs due to missing server-side step verification, allowing unauthenticated actors to circumvent security restrictions.
Web Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass in the Advanced IP Blocker plugin occurs due to missing server-side step verification, allowing unauthenticated actors to circumvent security restrictions.
Web Security.reason_zh: Advanced IP Blocker 插件因缺失服务端步骤验证导致身份验证绕过，允许未认证攻击者规避安全限制。

Web Security.reason: Presents an unauthenticated Remote Code Execution flaw in the SiteVault backup plugin, enabling immediate full server compromise without any credentials.
Web Security.reason_en: Presents an unauthenticated Remote Code Execution flaw in the SiteVault backup plugin, enabling immediate full server compromise without any credentials.
Web Security.reason_zh: SiteVault 备份插件存在未认证远程代码执行漏洞，无需任何凭据即可立即导致服务器被完全接管。

Web Security.reason: Allows unauthenticated arbitrary file uploads in the CodeBard Help Desk plugin, facilitating persistent web shell deployment and backend takeover.
Web Security.reason_en: Allows unauthenticated arbitrary file uploads in the CodeBard Help Desk plugin, facilitating persistent web shell deployment and backend takeover.
Web Security.reason_zh: CodeBard Help Desk 插件允许未认证任意文件上传，便于攻击者部署持久化 Web Shell 并接管后端。

Web Security.reason: Features an unauthenticated blind SQL injection in the uListing directory plugin, granting attackers direct access to extract sensitive database records.
Web Security.reason_en: Features an unauthenticated blind SQL injection in the uListing directory plugin, granting attackers direct access to extract sensitive database records.
Web Security.reason_zh: uListing 目录插件存在未认证盲 SQL 注入漏洞，使攻击者能够直接提取敏感数据库记录。

Web Security.reason: Exposes an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in the Payever WooCommerce gateway, leading to remote code execution via insecure deserialization.
Web Security.reason_en: Exposes an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in the Payever WooCommerce gateway, leading to remote code execution via insecure deserialization.
Web Security.reason_zh: Payever WooCommerce 支付网关存在未认证 PHP 对象注入漏洞，通过不安全的反序列化可导致远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Contains an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in the Booster for WooCommerce plugin, allowing attackers to bypass authentication and execute arbitrary code.
Web Security.reason_en: Contains an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in the Booster for WooCommerce plugin, allowing attackers to bypass authentication and execute arbitrary code.
Web Security.reason_zh: Booster for WooCommerce 插件存在未认证 PHP 对象注入漏洞，允许攻击者绕过身份验证并执行任意代码。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated local file inclusion in the Kids Care theme enables reading sensitive server configuration files and potentially chaining to remote code execution.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated local file inclusion in the Kids Care theme enables reading sensitive server configuration files and potentially chaining to remote code execution.
Web Security.reason_zh: Kids Care 主题存在未认证本地文件包含漏洞，可读取敏感服务器配置文件，并可能进一步链式利用以实现远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Triggers incorrect privilege assignment in the core WooCommerce plugin, affecting millions of global e-commerce sites by allowing unauthorized role escalation.
Web Security.reason_en: Triggers incorrect privilege assignment in the core WooCommerce plugin, affecting millions of global e-commerce sites by allowing unauthorized role escalation.
Web Security.reason_zh: 核心 WooCommerce 插件触发错误的权限分配，允许未授权的角色提升，影响全球数百万电子商务站点。

Web Security.reason: Grants subscriber-level privilege escalation in the AIWU plugin, compromising WordPress installation integrity by elevating low-privileged user accounts to administrators.
Web Security.reason_en: Grants subscriber-level privilege escalation in the AIWU plugin, compromising WordPress installation integrity by elevating low-privileged user accounts to administrators.
Web Security.reason_zh: AIWU 插件允许订阅者级别的用户权限提升，通过将低权限账户提权至管理员级别，破坏 WordPress 安装环境的完整性。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in a widely deployed WordPress theme allows attackers to execute arbitrary code without credentials, posing a severe threat to site integrity and data confidentiality.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in a widely deployed WordPress theme allows attackers to execute arbitrary code without credentials, posing a severe threat to site integrity and data confidentiality.
Web Security.reason_zh: 广泛使用的 WordPress 主题存在未认证 PHP 对象注入漏洞，攻击者无需凭据即可执行任意代码，对站点完整性和数据机密性构成严重威胁。

Web Security.reason: Critical Local File Inclusion flaw in DirectoryPress enables unauthenticated actors to read sensitive server files, which can lead to credential theft or full system compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: Critical Local File Inclusion flaw in DirectoryPress enables unauthenticated actors to read sensitive server files, which can lead to credential theft or full system compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: DirectoryPress 存在严重的本地文件包含漏洞，允许未认证攻击者读取敏感服务器文件，可能导致凭证窃取或系统被完全接管。

Web Security.reason: Authentication bypass in Wukong_HRM allows unauthenticated users to invoke all HRM APIs, directly exposing highly sensitive employee financial records and personal identifiable information.
Web Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Wukong_HRM allows unauthenticated users to invoke all HRM APIs, directly exposing highly sensitive employee financial records and personal identifiable information.
Web Security.reason_zh: Wukong_HRM 存在身份验证绕过漏洞，允许未认证用户调用所有人力资源管理 API，直接暴露高度敏感的员工财务记录和个人身份信息。

Web Security.reason: Missing authorization checks in Wukong_HRM enable low-privileged employees to escalate privileges and read confidential payroll and banking data across the entire organization.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing authorization checks in Wukong_HRM enable low-privileged employees to escalate privileges and read confidential payroll and banking data across the entire organization.
Web Security.reason_zh: Wukong_HRM 缺失授权检查，使低权限员工能够提升权限并读取全公司范围内的机密薪资和银行数据。

Web Security.reason: SQL injection in Xinhu Rainrock RockOA's Openkqj component allows attackers to manipulate database queries, risking unauthorized data extraction, modification, or administrative control.
Web Security.reason_en: SQL injection in Xinhu Rainrock RockOA's Openkqj component allows attackers to manipulate database queries, risking unauthorized data extraction, modification, or administrative control.
Web Security.reason_zh: Xinhu Rainrock RockOA 的 Openkqj 组件存在 SQL 注入漏洞，攻击者可操纵数据库查询，面临未授权数据提取、篡改或获取管理控制权的風險。

Web Security.reason: Improper authentication via X-Forwarded-For header manipulation in Sencho's login endpoint allows attackers to bypass security controls and gain unauthorized access to protected resources.
Web Security.reason_en: Improper authentication via X-Forwarded-For header manipulation in Sencho's login endpoint allows attackers to bypass security controls and gain unauthorized access to protected resources.
Web Security.reason_zh: Sencho 登录端点通过操纵 X-Forwarded-For 头进行不当的身份验证，允许攻击者绕过安全控制并未经授权访问受保护资源。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Authenticated users can manipulate database names passed to system backup commands, resulting in remote code execution on database management servers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Authenticated users can manipulate database names passed to system backup commands, resulting in remote code execution on database management servers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 已认证用户可操纵传递给系统备份命令的数据库名称，导致数据库管理服务器上发生远程代码执行。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Uncontrolled search path vulnerability in ImageMagick on Windows allows attackers to plant malicious executables in working directories, leading to unintended code execution during routine image processing tasks.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Uncontrolled search path vulnerability in ImageMagick on Windows allows attackers to plant malicious executables in working directories, leading to unintended code execution during routine image processing tasks.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Windows 版 ImageMagick 存在不受控搜索路径漏洞，允许攻击者在工作目录植入恶意可执行文件，导致常规图像处理任务中意外执行代码。

Other.reason: Regression in the Linux SMB client's oplock break validation removes critical data offset bounds checking, potentially causing memory corruption or unexpected protocol parsing failures.
Other.reason_en: Regression in the Linux SMB client's oplock break validation removes critical data offset bounds checking, potentially causing memory corruption or unexpected protocol parsing failures.
Other.reason_zh: Linux SMB 客户端的 oplock 中断验证出现回归缺陷，移除了关键的数据偏移量边界检查，可能导致内存损坏或意外的协议解析失败。

Other.reason: Use-after-free flaw in GPAC's MP4Box component can be triggered remotely via crafted media files, potentially causing application crashes or arbitrary code execution in affected media processing environments.
Other.reason_en: Use-after-free flaw in GPAC's MP4Box component can be triggered remotely via crafted media files, potentially causing application crashes or arbitrary code execution in affected media processing environments.
Other.reason_zh: GPAC 的 MP4Box 组件存在释放后使用（Use-after-Free）漏洞，可通过构造的媒体文件远程触发，可能导致受影响媒体处理环境中的应用崩溃或任意代码执行。

summary: The day's curated vulnerabilities highlight a severe concentration of web-based attacks, primarily targeting the WordPress ecosystem with widespread remote code execution, file upload, and authentication bypass flaws across multiple plugins. Critical infrastructure and IoT sectors face distinct dangers, including unauthenticated remote code execution in openPDC power grid monitors and TOZED network printers, as well as a fundamental entropy flaw in NXP microcontrollers that compromises cryptographic integrity. Additional high-impact findings include an AWS Bedrock agent core vulnerability enabling unauthorized tool invocation, command injection risks affecting GNU Emacs development environments, and a remote exploit for OpenSpug server management tools that poses immediate takeover potential.
summary_en: The day's curated vulnerabilities highlight a severe concentration of web-based attacks, primarily targeting the WordPress ecosystem with widespread remote code execution, file upload, and authentication bypass flaws across multiple plugins. Critical infrastructure and IoT sectors face distinct dangers, including unauthenticated remote code execution in openPDC power grid monitors and TOZED network printers, as well as a fundamental entropy flaw in NXP microcontrollers that compromises cryptographic integrity. Additional high-impact findings include an AWS Bedrock agent core vulnerability enabling unauthorized tool invocation, command injection risks affecting GNU Emacs development environments, and a remote exploit for OpenSpug server management tools that poses immediate takeover potential.
summary_zh: 今日精选漏洞凸显了基于 Web 的攻击高度集中，主要针对 WordPress 生态系统，多个插件中存在广泛的远程代码执行、文件上传和身份验证绕过漏洞。关键基础设施和物联网领域面临特定风险，包括 openPDC 电网监控器和 TOZED 网络打印机中的未认证远程代码执行，以及破坏密码学完整性的 NXP 微控制器基础熵缺陷。其他高影响发现还包括：AWS Bedrock 代理核心漏洞允许未授权工具调用、影响 GNU Emacs 开发环境的命令注入风险，以及 OpenSpug 服务器管理工具的远程利用代码，具备立即接管服务器的潜力。
